We have many templates. Need to find one that matches our three precursors: tertiary amine (CCN(C(C)C)C(C)C), aryl chloride (COc1ccnc(Cl)c1), and amide (NC(=O)c1nnn(Cc2ccc(CN3CC(F)C3)cc2)c1N). The template should have three reactants: a tertiary amine (maybe as a base), an aryl halide, and an amide (or acyl component). The product is the aryl ketone attached to heterocycle.

Looking at the results, many templates involve halide and carbonyl but also other groups. The one that seems plausible is reaction_id 1729791: It has functional groups broken halide and formed ketone? Let's examine its mapped_rxn:

Mapped_rxn: '[CH3:1][n:2]1[n:3][cH:4][cH:5][c:6]1[CH:7]=[O:8].Cn1cc[n+](C)c1.CC(=O)O.[Cl-].[NH2:21][C:20](=[O:22])[C:19]1([c:18]2[cH:17][cH:16][cH:15][c:14]([S:13][c:12]3[cH:11][n:10][c:9](Cl)[c:30]([Cl:31])[cH:29]3)[cH:28]2)[CH2:23][CH2:24][O:25][CH2:26][CH2:27]1.[H-].[Na+].CN(C)C=O.O>>[CH3:1][n:2]1[n:3][cH:4][cH:5][c:6]1[C:7](=[O:8])[c:9]1[n:10][cH:11][c:12]([S:13][c:14]2[cH:15][cH:16][cH:17][c:18]([C:19]3([C:20]([NH2:21])=[O:22])[CH2:23][CH2:24][O:25][CH2:26][CH2:27]3)[cH:28]2)[cH:29][c:30]1[Cl:31]'

This is a complex heterocycle with a thioether etc. Not our case.

We need a template that includes a tertiary amine as a reagent. The functional group list includes "tert-butyl" etc. The tertiary amine is CCN(C(C)C)C(C)C, which is diisopropyl ethyl? Actually it's N,N-diisopropyl ethyl? Let's detect functional groups: It is a tertiary amine. So functional_groups_formed maybe "tert-butyl"? Not.

But we can search for templates that have a tertiary amine in reactants. Use detect_functional_groups on the amine? But we can search for templates containing "tert-butyl" maybe.

Better: Use get_template for a specific template ID that seems to match. The template we need likely is a known Friedel-Crafts acylation template. Could be template_id something like 1914393? That one has Cl-CH2-aryl, not direct aryl chloride. Not.

Maybe the template is not in top 20; we need to search with functional_groups_broken "aryl halide" and formed "ketones". Let's try search with functional_groups_broken ["aryl halide"] and functional_groups_formed ["ketones"].
